notes.title: 2025.1.7 UPDATE
notes.content:
<Bug Patch>
- Fixed a bug where the ore chest was reset after game play ended.
- Fix drag bugs related to alchemy.
- Set the maximum quantity of possession of each good and item (up to 1 billion)
- Fix a bug that contains language-related Korean.
- Modifying the display of upgrade notifications to be real-time.
- Limiting the character limit to a maximum of 50 (preventing bugs and frame drops due to large amounts)
- Time Piece Upgrade of Time Speed : Max level 48 to 28 (up to 4x speed)

<Balance Patch>
- Mushroom Library: Revised to MAX level 20 of horror mushrooms.
